While keys are present, their mechanical logic is questionable. Some rods appear to terminate abruptly or merge into the wood without clear mounting points. The complexity of the bassoon keywork is simplified, with some keys appearing fused or geometrically inconsistent.
The mullions of the window in the background show slight waviness and inconsistency in thickness, indicating minor geometric instability in the background elements.
